# `openinference` attributes

| Key | Type | Description | Examples | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="openinference-project-name"></a>`openinference.project.name` | string | The name of the project that the telemetry belongs to. | `default`, `my-llm-app` | Development |
| <a id="openinference-span-kind"></a>`openinference.span.kind` | string (well-known values) | The role an operation plays in an AI application. |  | Development |

## Notes

- `openinference.project.name`: Recorded as a resource attribute, not a span attribute.
- `openinference.span.kind`: Required on every OpenInference span. It is distinct from OpenTelemetry's own `SpanKind`. See [Span Kinds](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/blob/main/spec/general/span-kinds.md).

## `openinference.span.kind` values

`openinference.span.kind` has the following well-known values. If one of them applies, it MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `LLM` | A call to a large language model. |
| `EMBEDDING` | Generation of vector embeddings. |
| `CHAIN` | A link between application steps, or the start of a request. |
| `RETRIEVER` | A query to a vector store, search engine, or database. |
| `RERANKER` | Reordering of candidate documents by relevance. |
| `TOOL` | Execution of a tool or function. |
| `AGENT` | A reasoning step that acts on tools using an LLM's guidance. |
| `GUARDRAIL` | An input or output moderation check. |
| `EVALUATOR` | An evaluation of a model's output. |
| `PROMPT` | The rendering of a prompt template. |
| `DECISION` | A call to a decision model. |
| `UNKNOWN` | Fallback used by SDKs when the kind of an operation cannot be determined. |
